card.name: Predisposing and manifestations of conditions
card.fires_on: The word predispose (the start 'predis' or the ending 'posing') and the word 'manifestations', when describing risk factors or signs of a condition such as seizures or infection.

modes.label: Predispose wording
modes.description: The start or end of 'predispose/predisposing/predisposition' after 'may' or 'familial', linking risk factors to a condition.
modes.example: or in the presence of other risk factors that may<< predis>>pose to seizures or lower the seizure threshold

modes.label: Manifestations of disease
modes.description: The word 'manifestations' naming signs or presentations of a disorder.
